# statusdrift_on_call_policy (Data Source)

Fetches a single on-call policy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_on_call_policy" "default" {
  name = "Default Escalation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the on-call policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the on-call policy.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default organization policy.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) Monitor group ID for group-scoped policies.
- `scope_type` (String) Policy scope type.
- `steps` (Attributes List) Escalation steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Read-Only:

- `delay_minutes` (Number) Delay in minutes before this step.
- `organization_member_id` (Number) Organization member ID.
- `position` (Number) Step position.
- `schedule_id` (Number) On-call schedule ID.
- `target_type` (String) Target type: schedule or member.
